items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps the routine comfortable for oily skin without adding more actives.
The glycolic toner suits your lower texture score and gives a smoother-looking surface, used at night.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier while you use an exfoliating acid.
A daily mineral SPF is essential because glycolic acid makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use the glycolic toner at night just 2 to 3 times a week at first, and wear the SPF every morning. We left out the retinol and benzoyl peroxide wash because using all three together often irritates and your scan shows no need for them now, though retinol can be added on alternate nights once your skin is settled.
